name: VxTeamPanel
author: Vxlancity
description: Self-hosted team management panel for Pterodactyl with dashboard, team management, tasks, meetings, applications, local persistence and repository-based updates.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

apt update
apt install -y git ca-certificates

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

echo '[VxTeamPanel] Installing source...'
rm -rf panel-source

if [ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN}" ]; then
  git -c http.extraheader="Authorization: Bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}" clone --depth 1 --single-branch --branch "${SOURCE_BRANCH}" "${SOURCE_REPOSITORY}" panel-source
else
  git clone --depth 1 --single-branch --branch "${SOURCE_BRANCH}" "${SOURCE_REPOSITORY}" panel-source
fi

if [ ! -f panel-source/package.json ]; then
  echo '[VxTeamPanel] ERROR: package.json not found in repository.'
  exit 1
fi

COMMIT=$(git -C panel-source rev-parse HEAD)
cp -a panel-source/. /mnt/server/
rm -rf /mnt/server/panel-source /mnt/server/.git
printf '%s\n' "${COMMIT}" > /mnt/server/.vxteam-commit

/usr/local/bin/npm install --omit=dev
mkdir -p /mnt/server/data
echo '[VxTeamPanel] Installation complete.'
exit 0
